title: Uncertawn's Jisho Implementation
description: Browse Japanese language dictionary from within Minecraft!
body:
This mod requires internet connection because it makes api calls to [Jisho.org](https://jisho.org/)

To open the dictonary press J

I am planning to add search history for convenience if you are anything like me and need to constantly look up same stuff over and over again.

Would love to hear what other features you would like me to add!
